description: The Chinese Small Telescope ARray (CSTAR) is a four-telescope optical array at Dome A in Antarctica, conducting wide-field high-cadence time-domain photometry in SDSS-like g, r, and i bands.
facility_description: CSTAR was installed at Dome A (Dome Argus, Kunlun Station) on the Antarctic plateau by the Chinese Center for Antarctic Astronomy.
notes: CSTAR uses four 14.5 cm telescopes with Andor 1k x 1k frame-transfer CCDs.
